title: Describe a Change in Routine

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

instructions: Write your own first draft; the fictional example is for study, not your submission.
prompt: Write 120–160 words to a friend about a fictional change in daily routine. Describe two past habits, what happens now, and how you would observe whether the plan fits your life. Use at least six lesson words and at least two used to sentences.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Use four parts: earlier routine; two past habits; present choices; a note about what you would observe. Treat the example as personal planning, not a medical instruction.

reference: Hi Nora, I have been thinking about a small change to my morning routine. I used to leave home without breakfast. I also used to go to bed at a different time each night. I often felt sleepy during my first meeting. Now I prepare a simple snack the evening before and put water in my bag. I also write my bedtime in a journal, so I can remember when I went to sleep. At lunch I sometimes stretch or take a short walk with a colleague. I do not expect one habit to explain my mood or remove every kind of stress. A cooking guide helped me learn the words protein and fiber, and I want to check its source before repeating a claim. The changes are gradual, and I will keep only the parts that fit my lifestyle. If I have a health concern, I will ask an appropriate professional.
